text.offer: You have proven yourself a disciple of Kraanan. One of our warrior-priests is ready to walk the world beside you. Ask me for a companion, and they will swear to you before the Eternal.
text.progress: Stand before Kraanan's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Kraanan smiles on those who fight together. Honour your companion, and your bond will grow.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before Kraanan's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
